answer: In this PoA design, each agent’s EigenTrust reputation is temporally decayed with an exponential half-life, so influence is earned only through sustained honest service rather than brief activity. A freshly spawned sybil starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality and lacks trusted incoming edges, making it unable to pass consensus. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity reinforces corroborated links across the orchard, while an anchor and falcon cannot manufacture trust alone.
